analysis.purpose: Shared CLI runtime: resolves which project a command applies to, opens the soul, and rebuilds the derived index from it — always from the committed soul, so a stale index can never drift.
responsibilities: Resolve the project root through an explicit priority chain
Open the soul and rebuild the derived index from it
Build the index into a temporary file and move it into place atomically

businessRules.rule: The index is always rebuilt from the committed soul, never patched in place from an unknown state.
businessRules.rationale: The soul is the source of truth; a drifted derived index is worse than a missing one.

businessRules.rule: Root resolution is a priority chain so one user-scoped IDE entry can serve every project.
businessRules.rationale: Users should not need a per-project MCP entry.

edges.rationale: This file is the shared CLI runtime.
